description: This file defines the 'Weight' class within the 'Opencart\System\Library\Cart' namespace. It manages weight conversions, formatting, and retrieval of weight units, and includes interactions with a database to load weight class data.

classes.name: Weight
classes.description: A class responsible for managing weight units, conversions, formatting, and data related to weight classes in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Weight class by loading weight class data from the database based on current language ID.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a weight value from one unit to another based on loaded weight class data.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a weight value according to the specified weight class, decimal point, and thousand separator.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the unit of measurement for a specific weight class.
